bphs_house_lords.1_1: 1. Effects of Lagna's Lord in various Bhavas (up to sloka 12): Should Lagna's lord be in Lagna itself, the person will be endowed with physical happiness (i.e. good health) and prowess. He will be intelligent and will have a fickle mind. He will have two wives and will unite with other females.
bphs_house_lords.1_2: 2. If Lagna's lord is in Dhana, he will be gainful, scholarly, happy and endowed with good qualities. He will be religious, honorable and will have many wives.
bphs_house_lords.1_3: 3. If Lagna's lord is in Sahaj Bhava, the person will equal a lion in valor and  will be endowed with all kinds of wealth. He will be honorable and will have two wives. He will be intelligent and happy.
bphs_house_lords.1_4: 4. If Lagna's lord is in Bandhu Bhava, the person will be endowed with paternal and maternal happiness. He will have many brothers, be lustful, virtuous and charming.
bphs_house_lords.1_5: 5. If Lagna's lord is in Putra Bhava, the person will have mediocre happiness as regards progeny. He will lose his first child. He will be honorable, given to anger, and be dear to the king.
bphs_house_lords.1_6: 6. If Lagna's lord is in Ari Bhava and related to a malefic the person will be devoid of physical happiness and will be troubled by enemies, if there is no benefic drishti.
bphs_house_lords.1_7: If the graha in question is a benefic, the person will wander aimlessly, face penury and be dejected. Alternatively, he will become a king (if the said graha is strong).
bphs_house_lords.1_8: 8. If Lagna's lord is in Randhra Bhava, the person will be an accomplished scholar, sickly, prone to stealing and given to much anger. He will be a gambler and will have relationships with others' wives.
bphs_house_lords.1_9: 9. If Lagna's lord is in Dharma Bhava, the person will be fortunate, dear to people and will be a devotee of Shri Vishnu. He will be skilful and eloquent in speech. He will be endowed with wife, sons, and wealth.
bphs_house_lords.1_10: 10. If Lagna's lord is in Karma Bhava, the person will be endowed with paternal happiness, royal honor (or patronage), and fame among men. He will doubtlessly have self earned wealth.
bphs_house_lords.1_11: 11. If Lagna's lord is in Labha Bhava, the person will always be endowed with gains, good qualities, fame, and many wives.
bphs_house_lords.1_12: 12. If Lagna's lord is in Vyaya Bhava and is devoid of a benefic drishti and/or yuti, the person will be bereft of physical happiness. He will not spend fruitfully and will be prone to much  anger.
bphs_house_lords.2_1: 13. Effects of Dhana's Lord in various Bhavas (up to sloka 24): If Dhana's lord is in Tanu Bhava, the person will be endowed with sons and wealth. He will be inimical to his family and will be lustful. He will be hard hearted and will do other's jobs.
bphs_house_lords.2_2: 14. If Dhana's lord is in Dhana Bhava, the person will be wealthy, proud, will have two or more wives and will be bereft of progeny.
bphs_house_lords.2_3: 15. If Dhana's lord is in Sahaj Bhava, the person will be valorous, wise, virtuous, lustful, and miserly; all these are true when related to a benefic. If related to a malefic, the person will be a heterodox.
bphs_house_lords.2_4: If Dhana's lord is exalted and is yuti with Guru, the person will be equal to a king.
bphs_house_lords.2_5: 17. If Dhana's lord is in Putra Bhava the person will be wealthy. Not only the person, but also his sons, will be intent on earning wealth.
bphs_house_lords.2_6: if Dhana's lord is yuti with a malefic, there will be loss through enemies, apart from mutilation of shanks (lower part of leg).
bphs_house_lords.2_7: If a malefic is related to the said placement by yuti or by drishti with Dhana's lord, the person's wife will (also) be of questionable character.
bphs_house_lords.2_8: 20. If Dhana's lord is in Randhra Bhava, the person will be endowed with abundant land and wealth. But, he will have limited marital felicity and will be bereft of happiness from his elder brother.
bphs_house_lords.2_9: 21. If Dhana's lord is in Dharma Bhava, the person will be wealthy, diligent, skilful, sick during childhood, and will later on be happy (i.e. healthy). He will visit shrines and observe religious codes.
bphs_house_lords.2_10: 22. If Dhana's lord is in Karma Bhava, the person will be lustful, honorable, and learned; he will have many wives and much wealth, but he will be bereft of filial happiness.
bphs_house_lords.2_11: 23. If Dhana's lord is in Labha Bhava, the person will have all kinds of wealth, be ever diligent, honorable, and famous.
bphs_house_lords.2_12: 24. If Dhana's lord is in Vyaya Bhava, the person will be adventurous, be devoid of wealth, and be interested in other's wealth. His eldest child will not keep him happy.
bphs_house_lords.3_1: 25. Effects of Sahaj's Lord in various Bhavas (up to sloka 36): If Sahaj's lord is in Tanu Bhava, the person will have self made wealth. He will be disposed to worship and will be valorous, and intelligent, although devoid of learning.
bphs_house_lords.3_2: 26. If Sahaj's lord is in Dhana Bhava, the person will be corpulent and devoid of valor. He will not make much effort, be unhappy, and will have an eye on others' wives and others' wealth.
bphs_house_lords.3_3: 27. If Sahaj's lord is in Sahaj Bhava, the person will be endowed with happiness through siblings, and will have wealth and sons. He will be cheerful and extremely happy.
bphs_house_lords.3_4: 28. If Sahaj's lord is in Bandhu Bhava, the person will be happy, wealthy and intelligent, but will acquire a wicked spouse.
bphs_house_lords.3_5: If in the process, Sahaj's lord is yuti with, or receives a drishti from a malefic, the person will have a formidable wife.
bphs_house_lords.3_6: 30. If Sahaj's lord is in Ari Bhava, the person will be inimical to his siblings and will be affluent. He will not be well disposed to his maternal uncle and will be dear to his maternal aunt.
bphs_house_lords.3_7: 31. If Sahaj's lord is in Yuvati Bhava, the person will be interested in serving the king. He will not be happy during boyhood, but at the end of his life, he will be happy.
bphs_house_lords.3_8: 32. If Sahaj's lord is in Randhra Bhava, the person will be a thief and will earn his livelihood from serving others. He will die at the gate of the royal palace.
bphs_house_lords.3_9: 33. If Sahaj's lord is in Dharma Bhava, the person will lack paternal bliss, and will make fortunes through his spouse. He will have progeny and other pleasures.
bphs_house_lords.3_10: 34. If Sahaj's lord is in Karma Bhava, the person will have all kinds of happiness and self made wealth. He will like nurturing wicked females.
bphs_house_lords.3_11: 35. If Sahaj's lord is in Labha Bhava, then the person will always gain in trading. He will be intelligent, although not literate. He will be adventurous and will serve others.
bphs_house_lords.3_12: 36. If Sahaj's lord is in Vyaya, the person will spend on evil deeds. He will have a wicked father and will be fortunate through a female (or wife).
bphs_house_lords.4_1: 37. Effects of Bandhu's Lord in various Bhavas (up to sloka 48): If Bandhu's lord is in Tanu Bhava, the person will be endowed with learning, virtues, ornaments, land, conveyances, and maternal happiness.
bphs_house_lords.4_2: 38. If Bandhu's lord is in Dhana Bhava, the person will enjoy pleasures, all kinds of wealth, family life and honor. He will be adventurous and will be cunning in disposition.
bphs_house_lords.4_3: 39. If Bandhu's lord is in Sahaj Bhava, the person will be valorous and will have servants. He will be liberal, virtuous and charitable. He will possess self-earned wealth. He will be free from diseases.
bphs_house_lords.4_4: 40. If Bandhu's lord is in Bandhu, the person will be a minister and will possess all kinds of wealth. He will be skilful, virtuous and honorable. He will be learned, happy and be well disposed towards his spouse.
bphs_house_lords.4_5: 41. If Bandhu's lord is in Putra Bhava, the person will be happy and be liked by all. He will be devoted to Shri Vishnu. He will be virtuous, honorable and will have wealth earned by himself.
bphs_house_lords.4_6: 42. If Bandhu's lord is in Ari Bhava, the person will be devoid of maternal happiness and be given to anger. He will be a thief and a conjurer (or magician). He will be independent in action and be indisposed.
bphs_house_lords.4_7: 43. If Bandhu's lord is in Yuvati Bhava, the person will be endowed with a high degree of education. He will sacrifice his patrimony and be akin to the dumb in an assembly.
bphs_house_lords.4_8: 44. If Bandhu's lord is in Randhra Bhava, the person will be devoid of domestic and other comforts. He will not enjoy much parental happiness and will be equal to a neuter.
bphs_house_lords.4_9: 45. If Bandhu's lord is in Dharma Bhava, the person will be dear to the person and everyone. He will be devoted to God. He will be virtuous, honorable, and endowed with every kind of happiness.
bphs_house_lords.4_10: 46. If Bandhu's lord is in Karma Bhava, the person will enjoy royal honors. He will be an alchemist. He will be extremely pleased. He will enjoy pleasures and will conquer his five senses.
bphs_house_lords.4_11: 47. If Bandhu's lord is in Labha Bhava, the person will have fear of secret disease; he will be liberal, virtuous, charitable, and helpful to others.
bphs_house_lords.4_12: 48. If Bandhu's lord is in Vyaya Bhava, the person will be devoid of domestic and other comforts, will have vices and be foolish and indolent.
bphs_house_lords.5_1: 49. Effects of Putra's Lord in Various Bhavas (up to sloka 60): If Putra's lord is in Lagna, the person will be scholarly and be blessed with progeny. He will  be a miser, crooked, and will steal others' wealth.
bphs_house_lords.5_2: 50. If Putra's lord is in Dhana Bhava, the person will have many sons and wealth. He will be a paterfamilias. He will be honorable and will be attached to his spouse. He will be world famous.
bphs_house_lords.5_3: 51. If Putra's lord is in Sahaj, the person will be attached to his sibling. He will be a tale bearer and a miser. He will always be interested in his own work.
bphs_house_lords.5_4: 52. If Putra's lord is in Bandhu Bhava, the person will be happy, endowed with maternal happiness, wealth and intelligence. He will be a king, a minister or a preceptor.
bphs_house_lords.5_5: Putra's lord in Putra Bhava will however make the person virtuous and dear to friends.
bphs_house_lords.5_6: 54. If Putra's lord is in Ari Bhava, the person will obtain such sons who will be equal to his enemies,or will lose them, or will acquire an adopted or purchased son.
bphs_house_lords.5_7: 55. If Putra's lord is in Yuvati Bhava, the person will be honorable, very religious, blessed with progeny, and will be helpful to others.
bphs_house_lords.5_8: 56. If Putra's lord is in Randhra Bhava, the person will not have much happiness in relation to children. He will be troubled by cough and pulmonary disorders. He will be given to anger and will be devoid of happiness.
bphs_house_lords.5_9: 57. If Putra's lord is in Dharma Bhava, the person will be a prince or equal to him. He will author treatises, be famous, and will shine in his race.
bphs_house_lords.5_10: 58. If Putra's lord is in Karma Bhava, the person will enjoy a Raja Yoga and various pleasures, and be very famous.
bphs_house_lords.5_11: 59. If Putra's lord is in Labha Bhava, the person will be learned, dear to people and be an author of treatises. He will be very skilful, and will be endowed with many sons and wealth.
bphs_house_lords.5_12: 60. If Putra's lord is in Vyaya Bhava, the person will be bereft of happiness from his own sons, and will have an adopted or purchased son.
bphs_house_lords.6_1: 61. Effects of Ari's Lord in various Bhavas (up to sloka 72): If Ari's lord is in Tanu Bhava, the person will be sickly, famous, and inimical to his own men. He will be rich, honorable, adventurous, and virtuous.
bphs_house_lords.6_2: 62. If Ari's lord is in Dhana Bhava, the person will be adventurous, famous among his people and will live in alien countries (or places). He will be happy, be a skilful speaker, and will always be interested in his own work.
bphs_house_lords.6_3: 63. If Ari's lord is in Sahaj Bhava, the person will be prone to anger and be bereft of courage. He will be inimical to all his siblings, and will have disobedient servants.
bphs_house_lords.6_4: 64. If Ari's lord is in Bandhu Bhava, the person will be devoid of maternal happiness and will be intelligent, jealous, evil-minded, and very rich. He will be a tale bearer.
bphs_house_lords.6_5: 65. If Ari's lord is in Putra Bhava, the person will have fluctuating finances. He will have enmity with his sons and friends. He will be happy, selfish, and kind.
bphs_house_lords.6_6: 66. If Ari's lord is in Ari Bhava, the person will have enmity with the group of his kinsmen, but be friendly towards others. He will enjoy mediocre happiness in matters like wealth.
bphs_house_lords.6_7: 67. If Ari's lord is in Yuvati Bhava, the person will be deprived of happiness through wedlock. He will be famous, virtuous, honorable, adventurous, and wealthy.
bphs_house_lords.6_8: 68. If Ari's lord is in Randhra Bhava, the person will be sickly, inimical and will desire others' wealth. He will be interested in others' wives and will be impure (or degraded).
bphs_house_lords.6_9: 69. If Ari's lord is in Dharma Bhava, the person will trade in wood and stones ('Pashan' also means poison). He will have fluctuating professional fortunes.
bphs_house_lords.6_10: 70. If Ari's lord is in Karma Bhava, the person will be well known among his men, will not be respectfully disposed to his father and will be happy in foreign countries. He will be a gifted speaker.
bphs_house_lords.6_11: 71. If Ari's lord is in Labha Bhava, the person will gain wealth through his enemies. He will be virtuous and adventurous. He will be somewhat bereft of happiness of progeny.
bphs_house_lords.6_12: 72. If Ari's lord is in Vyaya Bhava, the person will always spend on vices. He will be hostile to learned people and will torture living beings.
bphs_house_lords.7_1: 73. Effects of Yuvati's Lord in various Bhavas (up to sloka 84): If Yuvati's lord is in Tanu Bhava, the person will visit others' wives. He will be wicked and skillful. He will be devoid of courage, and will be afflicted by gastric problems.
bphs_house_lords.7_2: 74. If Yuvati's lord is in Dhana Bhava, the person will have many wives. He will gain wealth through his wife. He will be procrastinating by temperament.
bphs_house_lords.7_3: 75. If Yuvati's lord is in Sahaj Bhava, the person will suffer loss of children. Sometimes, with great difficulty, a son may survive. There is also the possibility of a daughter surviving.
bphs_house_lords.7_4: 76. If Yuvati's lord is in Bandhu Bhava, the wife of the person will not be under his control. He will be truthful, intelligent, and religious. He will suffer from dental problems.
bphs_house_lords.7_5: 77. If Yuvati's lord is in Putra Bhava, the person will be honorable, endowed with all (i.e. seven principal) virtues and all kinds of wealth. He will always be in a happy state of mind.
bphs_house_lords.7_6: 78. If Yuvati's lord is in Ari Bhava, the person will have a sickly wife and will be inimical to her. He will be given to anger and will be devoid of happiness.
bphs_house_lords.7_7: 79. If Yuvati's lord is in Yuvati Bhava, the person will be endowed with happiness through wife. He will be courageous, skilful, and intelligent. But, he will be afflicted by gastric problems.
bphs_house_lords.7_8: 80. If Yuvati's lord is in Randhra Bhava, the person will be deprived of marital happiness. His spouse will be troubled by diseases, will be devoid of a good disposition and will not obey the person.
bphs_house_lords.7_9: 81. If Yuvati's lord is in Dharma Bhava, the person will have relationships with many women. He will be amiable towards his own wife and will have many undertakings (or assignments).
bphs_house_lords.7_10: 82. If Yuvati's lord is in Karma Bhava, the person will beget a disobedient wife. He will be religious and will be endowed with wealth, sons, etc.
bphs_house_lords.7_11: 83. If Yuvati's lord is in Labha Bhava, the person will gain wealth through his wife. He will not get much happiness from sons, and will have daughters.
bphs_house_lords.7_12: 84. If Yuvati's lord is in Vyaya Bhava, the person will incur penury, be a miser, and his livelihood will be related to clothes. His wife will be a spend thrift.
bphs_house_lords.8_1: 85. Effects of Randhra's Lord in various Bhavas (up to sloka 96): If Randhra's lord is in Tanu Bhava, the person will be devoid of physical felicity and will suffer from wounds. He will be hostile to gods and brahmins (or religious people).
bphs_house_lords.8_2: 86. If Randhra's lord is in Dhana Bhava, the person will be devoid of physical vigor. He will enjoy little wealth and will not regain lost wealth.
bphs_house_lords.8_3: 87. If Randhra's lord is in Sahaj Bhava, the person will be devoid of fraternal happiness. He will be indolent and devoid of servants and strength.
bphs_house_lords.8_4: 88. If Randhra's lord is in Bandhu Bhava, the child will be deprived of the mother. He will be devoid of a house, land, and happiness. He will doubtlessly betray his friends.
bphs_house_lords.8_5: 89. If Randhra's lord is in Putra Bhava, the person will be dull and will have a limited number of children. He will live long and be wealthy.
bphs_house_lords.8_6: 90. If Randhra's lord is in Ari Bhava, the person will win over his enemies and  be afflicted by diseases. During childhood, he will incur danger through snakes and water.
bphs_house_lords.8_7: 91. If Randhra's lord is in Yuvati Bhava, the person will have two wives. If Randhra's lord is yuti with a malefic in Yuvati Bhava, there will surely be downfall in his business (or livelihood).
bphs_house_lords.8_8: 92. If Randhra's lord is in Randhra Bhava, the person will be long lived. If the said graha is weak, while being in Randhra Bhava, the longevity will be moderate. Also, the person will be a thief, be blame worthy and will blame others as well.
bphs_house_lords.8_9: 93. If Randhra's lord is in Dharma Bhava, the person will betray his religion and be a heterodox. He will beget a wicked wife and will steal others' wealth.
bphs_house_lords.8_10: 94. If Randhra's lord is in Karma Bhava, the person will be devoid of paternal bliss. He will be a tale bearer and will be bereft of livelihood. If there is a drishti in the process from a benefic, then these evils will not mature.
bphs_house_lords.8_11: Should Randhra's lord be yuti with a benefic and be in Labha Bhava, the person will be long-lived.
bphs_house_lords.8_12: 96. If Randhra's lord is in Vyaya Bhava, the person will spend on evil deeds and will live a short life. This is more so, if there is a malefic additionally in the said bhava.
bphs_house_lords.9_1: 97. Effects of Dharma's Lord in various Bhavas (up to sloka 103): If Dharma's lord is in Lagna, the person will be fortunate (or prosperous) and will be honored by the king. He will be virtuous, charming, learned, and honored by the public.
bphs_house_lords.9_2: 98. If Dharma's lord is in Dhana Bhava, the person will be a scholar and will be dear to all. He will be wealthy, sensuous and endowed with happiness from wife, sons, etc.
bphs_house_lords.9_3: 99. If Dharma's lord is in Sahaj Bhava, the person will be endowed with fraternal bliss. He will be wealthy, virtuous, and charming.
bphs_house_lords.9_4: 100. If Dharma's lord is in Bandhu Bhava, the person will enjoy houses, conveyances, and happiness. He will have all kinds of wealth and will be devoted to his mother.
bphs_house_lords.9_5: 101. If Dharma's lord is in Putra Bhava, the person will be endowed with sons and prosperity, and is devoted to elders. He will be courageous, charitable, and learned.
bphs_house_lords.9_6: 102. If Dharma's lord is in Ari Bhava, the person will not enjoy much prosperity. He will be devoid of happiness from maternal relatives and will always be troubled by enemies.
bphs_house_lords.9_7: 103. 0 Brahmin, If Dharma's lord is in Yuvati Bhava, the person gets happiness after marriage. He will be virtuous and famous.
bphs_house_lords.9_8: 104. If Dharma's lord is in Randhra Bhava, the person will not be prosperous and will not enjoy happiness from his elder brother.
bphs_house_lords.9_9: 105. If Dharma's lord is in Dharma Bhava, the person will be endowed with abundant fortune, virtue, and beauty. He will enjoy much happiness from his siblings.
bphs_house_lords.9_10: 106. If Dharma's lord is in Karma Bhava, the person will be a king or equal to a king. He could also be a minister or an army chief. He will be virtuous and dear to all.
bphs_house_lords.9_11: 107. If Dharma's lord is in Labha Bhava, the person will enjoy financial gains everyday and be devoted to elders. He is virtuous, and meritorious in acts.
bphs_house_lords.9_12: 108. If Dharma's lord is in Vyaya Bhava, the person will incur loss of fortune, will always spend on auspicious acts, and will become poor due to entertainment of guests.
bphs_house_lords.10_1: 109. Effects of Karma's Lord in various Bhavas (up to sloka 120): If Karma's lord is in Tanu Bhava, the person will be scholarly and famous. He will be a poet. He will suffer from diseases in his adolescence, and is happy later on. His wealth will improve day by day.
bphs_house_lords.10_2: 110 If Karma's lord is in Dhana Bhava, the person will be wealthy, virtuous, honored by the king and charitable. He will enjoy happiness from father and others.
bphs_house_lords.10_3: 111. If Karma's lord is in Sahaj Bhava, the person will enjoy happiness from brothers and servants. He will be valorous, virtuous, eloquent, and truthful.
bphs_house_lords.10_4: 112. If Karma's lord is in Bandhu Bhava, the person will be happy. He will always be interested in his mother's welfare and will lord over conveyances, land and houses. He will be virtuous and wealthy.
bphs_house_lords.10_5: 113. If Karma's lord is in Putra Bhava, the person will be endowed with all kinds of learning; he will be always happy, wealthy and endowed with sons.
bphs_house_lords.10_6: 114. If Karma's lord is in Ari Bhava, the person will be bereft of paternal bliss. Although he may be skilful, he will be bereft of wealth and be troubled by enemies.
bphs_house_lords.10_7: 115. If Karma's lord is in Yuvati Bhava, the person will be endowed with happiness through wife. He will be intelligent, virtuous, eloquent, truthful, and religious.
bphs_house_lords.10_8: 116. If Karma's lord is in Randhra Bhava, the person will be devoid of (good) acts, long lived and intent on blaming others.
bphs_house_lords.10_9: 117. If Karma's lord is in Dharma Bhava, the person born of royal scion will become a king, whereas an ordinary person will be equal to a king. This placement will confer wealth and the happiness of progeny.
bphs_house_lords.10_10: 118. If Karma's lord is in Karma Bhava, the person will be skilful in all jobs, be valorous, truthful, and devoted to elders.
bphs_house_lords.10_11: 119. If Karma's lord is in Labha Bhava, the person will be endowed with wealth, happiness, and sons. He will be virtuous, truthful, and always delighted.
bphs_house_lords.10_12: 120. If Karma's lord is in Vyaya Bhava, the person will spend through royal abodes (i.e. kings), will have fear from enemies, and will be worried in spite of being skilful.
bphs_house_lords.11_1: 121. Effects of Labha's Lord in various Bhavas (up to sloka 132): If Labha's lord is in Tanu Bhava, the person will be genuine in disposition, be rich, happy and even-sighted. He will be a poet. He will be eloquent in speech and always be endowed with gains.
bphs_house_lords.11_2: 122. If Labha's lord is in Dhana Bhava, the person will be endowed with all kinds of wealth and all kinds of accomplish- ments. He will be charitable, religious, and always happy.
bphs_house_lords.11_3: 123. If Labha's lord is in Sahaj Bhava, the person will be skilful in all jobs and will be wealthy. He will be endowed with fraternal bliss, and may sometimes suffer gout pain.
bphs_house_lords.11_4: 12. If Labha's lord is in Bandhu Bhava, the person will gain from maternal relatives. He will undertake visits to shrines and will possess happiness of house and lands.
bphs_house_lords.11_5: 125. If Labha's lord is in Putra Bhava, the person will be happy, educated and virtuous. He will be religious and happy.
bphs_house_lords.11_6: 126. If Labha's lord is in Ari Bhava, the person will be afflicted by diseases. He will be cruel and will be troubled by enemies. He will be living in foreign places.
bphs_house_lords.11_7: 127. If Labha's lord is in Yuvati Bhava, the person will always gain through his wife's relatives. He will be liberal, virtuous, sensuous, and will remain at the command of his spouse.
bphs_house_lords.11_8: 128. If Labha's lord is in Randhra Bhava, the person will incur reversals in his undertakings. He will live long while his wife will predecease him.
bphs_house_lords.11_9: 129. If Labha's lord is in Dharma Bhava, the person will be fortunate, skilful and truthful. He will be honored by the king, and will be affluent.
bphs_house_lords.11_10: 130. If Labha's lord is in Karma Bhava, the person will be honored by the king, and will be virtuous. He will be attached to his religion. He will be intelligent, truthful, and will subdue his senses.
bphs_house_lords.11_11: 131. If Labha's lord is in Labha Bhava, the person will gain in all his undertakings while his learning and happiness will be on the increase every day.
bphs_house_lords.11_12: 132. If Labha's lord is in Vyaya Bhava, the person will always depend on good deeds, be sensuous, will have many wives and will make friends with barbarians (or foreigners in general).
bphs_house_lords.12_1: 133. Effects of Vyaya's Lord in various Bhavas (up to sloka 144): If Vyaya's lord is in Tanu Bhava, the person will be a spend thrift and will be weak in constitution. He will suffer from phlegmatic disorders, and be devoid of wealth and learning.
bphs_house_lords.12_2: 134. If Vyaya's lord is in Dhana Bhava, the person will always spend on inauspicious deeds. He will be religious, will speak sweetly, and will be endowed with virtue and happiness.
bphs_house_lords.12_3: 135. If Vyaya's lord is in Sahaj Bhava, the person will be devoid of fraternal bliss, will hate others and will be quite selfish.
bphs_house_lords.12_4: 136. If Vyaya's lord is in Bandhu Bhava, the person will be devoid of maternal happiness. Everyday, he will accrue losses with respect to land, conveyances, and houses.
bphs_house_lords.12_5: 137. If Vyaya's lord is in Putra Bhava, the person will be bereft of sons and learning. He will spend on and visit shrines in order to beget a son.
bphs_house_lords.12_6: 138. If Vyaya's lord is in Ari Bhava, the person will incur enmity with his own men. He will be given to anger. He will be sinful, miserable, and will visit others' wives.
bphs_house_lords.12_7: If Vyaya's lord is in Yuvati Bhava, the person will incur expenditure on account of his wife. He will not enjoy conjugal bliss, and will be bereft of learning and strength.
bphs_house_lords.12_8: 140. If Vyaya's lord is in Randhra Bhava, the person will always gain in life. He will speak affably and will enjoy a medium span of life. He will be endowed with all good qualities.
bphs_house_lords.12_9: 141. If Vyaya's lord is in Dharma Bhava, the person will dishonor his elders, be inimical even to his friends and always be intent on achieving his own ends.
bphs_house_lords.12_10: 142. If Vyaya's lord is in Karma Bhava, the person will incur expenditure through royal persons and will enjoy moderate paternal bliss only.
bphs_house_lords.12_11: 143. If Vyaya's lord is in Labha Bhava, the person will incur losses, be brought up by others, and will sometimes gain through others.
bphs_house_lords.12_12: 144. If Vyaya's lord is in Vyaya Bhava, the person will face heavy expenditure, will not have physical felicity and will be irritable and spiteful. > 145-148. Miscellaneous: O Brahmin, those are the effects of bhava lords which are to be deduced considering their strength and weaknesses. In the case of a graha owning two bhavas, the results are to be deduced based on its two lordships (for the same placement). If contrary results are thus indicated, the results will be nullified and results of a varied nature will come to pass. The graha will yield full, half, or a quarter of the effects according to its strength being full, medium, and negligible respectively. Thus, I have told you about the effects due to bhava lords in various bhavas. u c

saravali_navamshas.1_1: Effects of Aries Ascendant, First Navamsha: The native will have a face resembling that of a he-goat, with nose and shoulders not being very prominent. He will have a fierce voice, ugly appearance and narrow eyes. His body will be thin but free from defects.
saravali_navamshas.1_2: Effects of Aries Ascendant, Second Navamsha: The native will be dark in complexion, will have broad shoulders and long arms. small forehead, strong collar bones, sharp sight and prominent face and nose. He will be an affable speaker and will possess weak legs.
saravali_navamshas.1_3: Effects of Aries Ascendant, Third Navamsha: The native will suffer loss of hair, be fair in complexion, will have irregular (defective) arms, charming eyes and nose, will be a scholar in direct poetic ability and will have weak thighs.
saravali_navamshas.1_4: Effects of Aries Ascendant, Fourth Navamsha: The native will have an erratic sight, be irascible, short-nosed, wandering-natured, will have rough legs and coarse hair, be bereft of co-born and emaciated.
saravali_navamshas.1_5: Effects of Aries Ascendant, Fifth Navamsha: The native will be fierce, and will have eyes resembling that of a supreme elephant, a fat nose, thick eye brows, wide fore face, fat body and coarse hair.
saravali_navamshas.1_6: Effects of Aries Ascendant, Sixth Navamsha: The native will be dark in complexion, soft in disposition, will have eyes akin to that of a deer, be tall in stature, will have irregular (defective) stomach and hands, be a eunuch, be timid and garrulous.
saravali_navamshas.1_7: Effects of Aries Ascendant, Seventh Navamsha: The native will have complexion akin to green sprout, be fickle minded, will possess white eyes, will marry an unchaste lady, be malicious and will have a broad physique.
saravali_navamshas.1_8: Effects of Aries Ascendant, Eighth Navamsha: The native will have a face akin to that of a monkey, be a good speaker, will have an afflicted and tawny body, will suffer from secret diseases, be torturous, be a liar, be fond of friends and be fierce.
saravali_navamshas.1_9: Effects of Aries Ascendant, Ninth Navamsha: The native will be tall, emaciated, wandering, will have defective foreface and ears, will have a face akin to that of a horse, will possess many names and be crooked. 11-19. EFFECTS OF NAVAMSHAS IN TAURUS: Following are the effects due to births in the Navamshas belonging to Taurus ascendant:
saravali_navamshas.2_10: Effects of Taurus Ascendant, First Navamsha: The native will have an even and dark colored physique, be hard-hearted, will perform obsequies in the beginning and ending parts of his life, be base, will indulge in unnatural acts and will have crooked sight.
saravali_navamshas.2_11: Effects of Taurus Ascendant, Second Navamsha: The native will be endowed with majestic looks, be indolent, will have a bent body, be not very intelligent, will indulge in hostile acts and be a great liar.
saravali_navamshas.2_12: Effects of Taurus Ascendant, Third Navamsha: The native will be erratic in sight, be fierce, will have a short nose, be wandering natured, will have coarse legs and hair will have soft limbs, be beautiful, will have broad eyes and big limbs, be interested, in Sacrifices etc. and will have stiff legs and hands.
saravali_navamshas.2_1: Effects of Taurus Ascendant, Fourth Navamsha: The native will be short in stature, will be wandering natured, be easily irritable, will have eyes akin to that of a he-goat, be tawny in complexion, be poor and will steal others' wealth.
saravali_navamshas.2_2: Effects of Taurus Ascendant, Fifth Navamsha: The native will be vicious, will have a well-elevated nose, will appear like a giant ox, will have crooked hair, be sportive, will have large shoulders and hips.
saravali_navamshas.2_3: Effects of Taurus Ascendant, Sixth Navamsha: The native will have beautiful eyes and hair, be firm, be endowed with a fair complexioned physique, will speak sweetly, be pre-eminent, be fond of amusements, be emaciated and skillful.
saravali_navamshas.2_4: Effects of Taurus Ascendant, Seventh Navamsha: The native will be interested in females who lost their sons, will have somewhat elevated nose and prominent eyes, will possess a strong physique, will hate his own men and will have stout feet and exquisite hair.
saravali_navamshas.2_5: Effects of Taurus Ascendant, Eighth Navamsha: The native will have eyes akin to that of a tiger and charming teeth, be unconquerable, will possess a full-blown nose, will work sparingly, will have curly and bluish hair and sharp nails and be garrulous.
saravali_navamshas.2_6: Effects of Taurus Ascendant, Ninth Navamsha: The native will be honorable, will not be very strong, be timid, given to anger, will possess an even and charming body, be a rogue (or cheat), will gather money, be famous, will have a thin lower body and will prattle. 20-28. Following are the effects of births in the nine Navamshas of Gemini ascendant:
saravali_navamshas.3_7: Effects of Gemini Ascendant, First Navamsha: The native will have hair on the shoulders, will possess charming and dark eyes and an elevated nose, be akin to green (Durva) grass in complexion and will possess thin legs and thin hands.
saravali_navamshas.3_8: Effects of Gemini Ascendant, Second Navamsha: The native will have a pot-like head, will do dirty acts, be fond of torturous deeds, will have depressed nose, will speak much, will work much and will lead in strife and quarrels.
saravali_navamshas.3_9: Effects of Gemini Ascendant, Third Navamsha: The native will be fair in complexion, will possess blood-red eyes, charming nose and even physique be very intelligent, will have a long face and dark eye-brows and be a skillful speaker.
saravali_navamshas.3_10: Effects of Gemini Ascendant, Fourth Navamsha: The native will possess charming eye brows and forehead, be lustful, will possess a physique with the splendour of a blue lotus, will be broad-chested and white teethed, be soft in speech and will have attractive hair.
saravali_navamshas.3_11: Effects of Gemini Ascendant, Fifth Navamsha: The native will have a broad face, strong chest and big head, be wicked, cunning and ,will possess charming and friendly looks.
saravali_navamshas.3_12: Effects of Gemini Ascendant, Sixth Navamsha: The native will possess eyes with the hue of honey, be garrulous, will possess a broad fore face, even body and charming lips, be a rogue, be fickle-minded and be strong.
saravali_navamshas.3_1: Effects of Gemini Ascendant, Seventh Navamsha: The native will possess a copper colored physique, copper red and prominent eyes and a broad chest, be skillful in teaching and arts and be jocular in disposition.
saravali_navamshas.3_2: Effects of Gemini Ascendant, Eighth Navamsha: The native will be dark in complexion, be great, intelligent, soft in disposition, sweet in speech, will have a broad and tall physique and large and black eyes and will be an expert in arts.
saravali_navamshas.3_3: Effects of Gemini Ascendant, Ninth Navamsha: The native will have round and dark colored eyes and charming body, be successful, very intelligent and be fond of sexual cohabitation, poetry and worldly knowledge. 29-37. Following are the effects for births in various Navamshas related to Cancer ascendant:
saravali_navamshas.4_4: Effects of Cancer Ascendant, First Navamsha: The native will have a clean, charming and fair colored physique, beautiful hair, broad belly, impressive face, prominent eyes, thin body and thin shoulders.
saravali_navamshas.4_5: Effects of Cancer Ascendant, Second Navamsha: The native will be blood red in complexion, be fierce in quarrels, will like fine arts, will possess face and eyes akin to that of a cat, will be well disposed to sacrify for others and will have weak knees and shanks.
saravali_navamshas.4_6: Effects of Cancer Ascendant, Third Navamsha: The native will be fair in complexion, will possess beautiful eyes, be an eloquent speaker, will have a soft body akin to that of a female, be intelligent be a sparing and light worker and be indolent
saravali_navamshas.4_7: Effects of Cancer Ascendant, Fourth Navamsha: The native will be black in complexion, will have pressed eyebrows, be graceful in appearance, will have charming eyes and nose, be courageous, liberal, will perform acts prescribed for superior caste-men and be crafty.
saravali_navamshas.4_8: Effects of Cancer Ascendant, Fifth Navamsha: The native will possess voice akin to the sound of bell, crooked or stooping face, allied eyebrows and very long arms, be interested in worship, be bereft of dutifulness, will injure others and be not very intelligent.
saravali_navamshas.4_9: Effects of Cancer Ascendant, Sixth Navamsha: The native will have a long and broad physique, charming eyes and great courage, be fair in complexion, be a good speaker and will possess beautiful nose and big teeth.
saravali_navamshas.4_10: Effects of Cancer Ascendant, Seventh Navamsha: The native will have scattered hair, big body and sinewy knees, will be disposed to protect others' families and will be akin to a crow in appearance.
saravali_navamshas.4_11: Effects of Cancer Ascendant, Eighth Navamsha: The native will have a head with bell shape, charming face, shoulders and limbs, will be a degraded artisan (i.e. an infamous worker), will have the gait of a tortoise and crooked nose and be dark in complexion.
saravali_navamshas.4_12: Effects of Cancer Ascendant, Ninth Navamsha: The native will be fair complexioned, will possess eyes resembling fish, be great, be soft-bellied, broad-chested, will have prominent chins and lips, large but weak knees and similar ankles. 38-46. Following effects will mature in the various Navamshas prevailing in Leo ascendant at birth:
saravali_navamshas.5_1: Effects of Leo Ascendant, First Navamsha: The native will have an even belly (like a lion), be fierce, will have sharp and blood-red nose and a big head, be valorous, and will possess a prominent and fleshy chest.
saravali_navamshas.5_2: Effects of Leo Ascendant, Second Navamsha: The native will have a prominent and broad fore face, a square body, broad eyes, broad chest, long arms and big nose.
saravali_navamshas.5_3: Effects of Leo Ascendant, Third Navamsha: The native will have hairy and broad arms, eyes akin to that of (Greek) partridge (said to live on moon-beams), be fickle-minded, charitable, will have an elevated nose, pure white physique and round neck.
saravali_navamshas.5_4: Effects of Leo Ascendant, Fourth Navamsha: The native will have (ash-colored) body akin to ghee, large and black eyes, soft hair, peculiar voice, big hands and legs and stomach resembling that of a frog.
saravali_navamshas.5_5: Effects of Leo Ascendant, Fifth Navamsha: The native will have a bell-shaped head with limited hair, charming nose and eyes, hairy body and long belly, be fierce, and will have unsightly teeth and strong and broad cheek.
saravali_navamshas.5_6: Effects of Leo Ascendant, Sixth Navamsha: The native will have limited but soft hair on his physique, white and large eyes, be tall in stature, dark in complexion, will have proven skill (only) among females, be swaggering and be learned.
saravali_navamshas.5_7: Effects of Leo Ascendant, Seventh Navamsha: The native will have a long face, be sinewy, will have a prominent physique, be unfortunate in the matter of wife (or females in general), dark-complexioned, fierce, hairy-bodied, and be cunning and harsh in speech.
saravali_navamshas.5_8: Effects of Leo Ascendant, Eighth Navamsha: The native will be endowed with excellent speech, firm limbs, charming and majestic looks, be undutiful, poor and crafty.
saravali_navamshas.5_9: Effects of Leo Ascendant, Ninth Navamsha: The native will have a face akin to a donkey's, will possess dark eyes, long arms, charming legs and be troubled by breathing disorders. 47-55. The various Navamshas emanating from Virgo ascendant at birth will give the following effects:
saravali_navamshas.6_10: Effects of Virgo Ascendant, First Navamsha: The native will possess eyes akin to that of an antelope, be a good speaker, be charitable, will enjoy sexual pleasures, be very rich, dark in complexion and large hearted.
saravali_navamshas.6_11: Effects of Virgo Ascendant, Second Navamsha: The native will have a charming face, charming eyes and fair complexion, be soft, argumentative, fickle minded and long-bellied.
saravali_navamshas.6_12: Effects of Virgo Ascendant, Third Navamsha: The native will have blown nose, prominent feet, long arms, pure speech, fair complexion and be friendly.
saravali_navamshas.6_1: Effects of Virgo Ascendant, Fourth Navamsha: The native will be learned, will be sportive with the fair sex, be beautiful, sweet, blood red in complexion, sharp, intelligent, emaciated and will have charming eyes and face.
saravali_navamshas.6_2: Effects of Virgo Ascendant, Fifth Navamsha: The native will have large lips and hands, big body, broad chest, strong ankles and will depend on others.
saravali_navamshas.6_3: Effects of Virgo Ascendant, Sixth Navamsha: The native will have charming appearance, impressive speech, splendorous body, be an exponent of Shastras, be very intelligent, skillful in writing and fine arts, be good hearted and will take pleasure in walking or roaming.
saravali_navamshas.6_4: Effects of Virgo Ascendant, Seventh Navamsha: The native will have a small face, elevated nose, compact arms, very fair complexion, prominent belly, hands and legs and will have fear for water.
saravali_navamshas.6_5: Effects of Virgo Ascendant, Eighth Navamsha: The native will be very beautiful, fair in complexion, tall in stature, will have charming eyes, be fierce, honorable and will have long and stout arms and brown hair.
saravali_navamshas.6_6: Effects of Virgo Ascendant, Ninth Navamsha: The native will be famous, will have charming physique, broad eyes, incomparable vigour, be skillful, be with stooping shoulders and be learned a writer. 56-64. The various Navamshas out of Libra ascendant at birth will produce following effects:
saravali_navamshas.7_7: Effects of Libra Ascendant, First Navamsha: The native will be fair complexioned, broad eyed, praiseworthy, long-faced, skillful in business, happy and famous.
saravali_navamshas.7_8: Effects of Libra Ascendant, Second Navamsha: The native will have squint and round eyes, elevated (ill formed) teeth, depressed waist, charming neck, large (physical) heart, ugly body and compact brows.
saravali_navamshas.7_9: Effects of Libra Ascendant, Third Navamsha: The native will be fair in complexion, will have a face akin to that of a horse, be thin-bodied, famous, long-haired and long-nosed and will have beautiful legs.
saravali_navamshas.7_10: Effects of Libra Ascendant, Fourth Navamsha: The native will have weak hands, be timid, will have ill-formed teeth (some placed over others), weak body, rolling eyes, small nails, dark complexion, and be devoid of virtues and be miserable.
saravali_navamshas.7_11: Effects of Libra Ascendant, Fifth Navamsha: The native will have majestic looks, be firm disposition, be not proud, rough haired, even-eyed and will possess a beautiful nose.
saravali_navamshas.7_12: Effects of Libra Ascendant, Sixth Navamsha: The native will have fleshy limbs, be fair in complexion, will have broad eyes, beautiful nose and white nails, be diplomatic and be learned in Shastras.
saravali_navamshas.7_1: Effects of Libra Ascendant, Seventh Navamsha: The native will be blood-red in complexion, be intelligent, will have long physique and long arms and a big head, be miserly, fierce and intelligent.
saravali_navamshas.7_2: Effects of Libra Ascendant, Eighth Navamsha: The native will have elevated shoulders and prominent neck, will enjoy pleasures, will have a coarse physique, long and dark brows, be a polite speaker and will have a beautiful chest and bruised head.
saravali_navamshas.7_3: Effects of Libra Ascendant, Ninth Navamsha: The native will have charming eyes, pleased mind, be fair complexioned, even and beautiful bodied, be skillful, fond of arts, be charitable and jocular. " 65-73. The ascendant Scorpio will produce various following effects according to the nine Navamshas thereof.
saravali_navamshas.8_4: Effects of Scorpio Ascendant, First Navamsha: The native will be short in stature, will have prominent lips and nose, charming forehead, strong and fair complexioned body with belly akin to that of a frog and will act as a marriage broker (ascertaining genealogies and negotiating marital alliances).
saravali_navamshas.8_5: Effects of Scorpio Ascendant, Second Navamsha: The native will be fair in complexion, will possess a strong and broad chest and shoulders and reddish eyes, will conquer his enemies be valorous and will have abundant hair.
saravali_navamshas.8_6: Effects of Scorpio Ascendant, Third Navamsha: The native will be learned, will have strong shoulders and arms and beautiful hair, be endowed with clear speech, fair complexion and charming lips. He is born of a virgin.
saravali_navamshas.8_7: Effects of Scorpio Ascendant, Fourth Navamsha: The native will be intent upon joining others' wives, will induce others to be active, be valorous, tall, dark in complexion, dark-haired and dark eyed.
saravali_navamshas.8_8: Effects of Scorpio Ascendant, Fifth Navamsha: The native will be majestic, will possess copper-red eyes, depressed nose, be courageous, proud, will perform fearful acts, be famous and will have a strong physique.
saravali_navamshas.8_9: Effects of Scorpio Ascendant, Sixth Navamsha: The native will be impudent, intelligent of a high order, will have elevated nose and great strength, will be endowed with knowledge of justice (or be diplomatic), be skillful, will possess less hair and compact brows.
saravali_navamshas.8_10: Effects of Scorpio Ascendant, Seventh Navamsha: The native will have a split face, strong body, teeth in various sizes, depressed belly, squint sight and be very splendorous.
saravali_navamshas.8_11: Effects of Scorpio Ascendant, Eighth Navamsha: The native will have blown nose, be dark in complexion, devoid of virtues, dirty in appearance, will possess stiff hair and be foolhardy.
saravali_navamshas.8_12: Effects of Scorpio Ascendant, Ninth Navamsha: The native will have a fair colored physique, be beautiful like a deer, will possess calm and tawny eyes and similar hair, and strong body and be amiable to elders. 74-82. The native born in Sagittarius ascendant but in its various Navamshas will obtain following effects:
saravali_navamshas.9_1: Effects of Sagittarius Ascendant, First Navamsha: The native will have charming big nose, will possess sight akin to that of a goat, be a gifted speaker, will have charming teeth and hair, be fair in complexion, will have inset testicles and be fierce.
saravali_navamshas.9_2: Effects of Sagittarius Ascendant, Second Navamsha: The native will have a prominent head, be firm in disposition, will have large eyes, strong waist and knees, ugly nose, tall stature and firm cheeks.
saravali_navamshas.9_3: Effects of Sagittarius Ascendant, Third Navamsha: The native will have skill in educating and in fine arts, be majestic, just, fond of females, intelligent and jocular.
saravali_navamshas.9_4: Effects of Sagittarius Ascendant, Fourth Navamsha: The native will be skillful, be tawny in complexion, will possess round eyes, fair-colored physique and a belly akin to tortoise, be intelligent, wandering-natured, will have charming hair and charming appearance.
saravali_navamshas.9_5: Effects of Sagittarius Ascendant, Fifth Navamsha: The native will have large ears, eyes and face, will possess a (majestic) physique like a lion, widely spread eye brows, strong shoulders and arms, hairless physique and firm disposition.
saravali_navamshas.9_6: Effects of Sagittarius Ascendant, Sixth Navamsha: The native will have beautiful and large eyes, broad forehead and broad face, be a poet, be mean and interested in scholarly discussions.
saravali_navamshas.9_7: Effects of Sagittarius Ascendant, Seventh Navamsha: The native will be dark in complexion, soft in disposition, will keep up his promise, will have a prominent head, will be interested in accumulating savings, be tall in stature, will possess broad eyes and be liberal.
saravali_navamshas.9_8: Effects of Sagittarius Ascendant, Eighth Navamsha: The native will be flat-nosed, broad headed, inimical, erratic sighted, garrulous and be dear to elders.
saravali_navamshas.9_9: Effects of Sagittarius Ascendant, Ninth Navamsha: The native will be fair in complexion, will have a face akin to that of a horse and broad and dark eyes, will speak sparingly, be truthful, miserable and will possess crooked walking limbs. 83-91. The various Navamshas resulting in the ascendant Capricorn will emanate the following effects:
saravali_navamshas.10_10: Effects of Capricorn Ascendant, First Navamsha : The native will have intersticed and outwardly visible teeth, be dark in complexion, will speak with broken words or be stammering, will have coarse hair, be famous, be interested in music and amusement, be emaciated and will have fluctuating wealth.
saravali_navamshas.10_11: Effects of Capricorn Ascendant, Second Navamsha: The native will be indolent, crafty, crooked nosed, fond of music, broad bodied, be interested in many females, will prattle much and be skillful.
saravali_navamshas.10_12: Effects of Capricorn Ascendant, Third Navamsha: The native will have lust for music, be famous, fair complexioned, be endowed with superior looks and charming nose, will be fond of many friends and relatives and achieves fulfillment of desires.
saravali_navamshas.10_1: Effects of Capricorn Ascendant, Fourth Navamsha: The native will have round eyes with a mix of blood-red and black hue, large forehead, emaciated body and thin arms, scattered hair, intersticed teeth and broken speech.
saravali_navamshas.10_2: Effects of Capricorn Ascendant, Fifth Navamsha: The native will have prominent neck, nose and belly, will enjoy pleasures, be attached to women, be dark in complexion, will have round knees and arms and will attain successful beginnings in his undertakings.
saravali_navamshas.10_3: Effects of Capricorn Ascendant, Sixth Navamsha: The native will possess a splendorous body, will attire charmingly, be libidinous, will possess small and even teeth, be a good speaker and will have big cheeks and large forehead .
saravali_navamshas.10_4: Effects of Capricorn Ascendant, Seventh Navamsha: The native will be dark in complexion, be indolent, be an eloquent speaker, be short-haired, big-bodied, be harsh in disposition, will possess soft hands and legs, be intelligent and very virtuous.
saravali_navamshas.10_5: Effects of Capricorn Ascendant, Eighth Navamsha: The native will be endowed with majestic sight and charming nose, reddish face, uneven nails and hair, grotesque body and forehead protruding like a pot.
saravali_navamshas.10_6: Effects of Capricorn Ascendant, Ninth Navamsha: The native will have broad chest and large eyes, high intelligence, fully developed face, interest in musical studies, be endowed with sweetness and strength, be gentle and diplomatic. 92-100. The various Navamshas ascending while Aquarius is on the east will produce following effects:
saravali_navamshas.11_7: Effects of Aquarius Ascendant, First Navamsha: The native will be dark in complexion, be soft in disposition, will have an emaciated body and prominent cheeks, be learned in poetry and Shastras, be libidinous, interested in carnal pleasures and be splendorous.
saravali_navamshas.11_8: Effects of Aquarius Ascendant, Second Navamsha: The native will possess coarse skin, nails, sight and hair, be kind to the helpless, be gentle, be tall in stature, foolish and will have a 'distinct' head.
saravali_navamshas.11_9: Effects of Aquarius Ascendant, Third Navamsha: The native will have a compact body (limbs sticking close to each other), be fond of females, will possess the splendour of lapis lazuli, be learned in the meanings of Shastras, and will act accordingly.
saravali_navamshas.11_10: Effects of Aquarius Ascendant, Fourth Navamsha: The native will be fond of women, be fair in complexion, will have a split face, will destroy enemies, be majestic, courageous and be fond of pleasures and sexual enjoyments.
saravali_navamshas.11_11: Effects of Aquarius Ascendant, Fifth Navamsha: The native will be learned in clear meanings of Shastras and in fine arts, will have coarse hair on legs, concealed (not prominent) neck and ears, and be dark in complexion.
saravali_navamshas.11_12: Effects of Aquarius Ascendant, Sixth Navamsha: The native will have a face resembling that of a tiger, be bold, short-haired, will have unchanging aims, will kill living beings viz. tiger, deer, snake etc. and be dear to king.
saravali_navamshas.11_1: Effects of Aquarius Ascendant, Seventh Navamsha: The native will have eyes and face resembling that of a goat, be fierce in disposition, be delighted in village life, insulted by females, will suffer diseases of bilious imbalances and be endowed with strength and courage.
saravali_navamshas.11_2: Effects of Aquarius Ascendant, Eighth Navamsha: The native will possess an undiminishing strength, firm be disposition and affection, be a warrior with the king or be a king himself, be beautiful and will have strong teeth and broad eyes.
saravali_navamshas.11_3: Effects of Aquarius Ascendant, Ninth Navamsha: The native will be dark in complexion, will possess unclean and elevated teeth, be disunited from his wife, children and wealth, be an affable speaker, and be famous and skillful. S 101-109. Should Pisces ascend at birth, the various Navamshas thereof will yield following specific effects:
saravali_navamshas.12_4: Effects of Pisces Ascendant, First Navamsha: Though the native may be white in complexion, his body will reveal the splendour of blood-red hue; he will be soft in disposition, be akin to a female in mental make up, (i.e. will act like a female), be fickle-minded and will have a short neck and emaciated waist.
saravali_navamshas.12_5: Effects of Pisces Ascendant, Second Navamsha: The native will have a big nose, be skillful in his assignments, will eat meat and the like, be endowed with a charming physique, will wander in forests and hills and will have a big head.
saravali_navamshas.12_6: Effects of Pisces Ascendant, Third Navamsha: The native will be white in complexion, be crafty, will possess beautiful eyes, be beautiful, righteous, learned, courteous, modest and charming in appearance.
saravali_navamshas.12_7: Effects of Pisces Ascendant, Fourth Navamsha: The native will have praiseworthy attributes, will fall into adversity, will serve aged people, be skillful in his assignments, learned, very strong versed in justice and will have elevated nose.
saravali_navamshas.12_8: Effects of Pisces Ascendant, Fifth Navamsha: The native will be tall in stature, dark in complexion, be valorous, be not peaceful, will have a small nose and charming eyes, be fond of torturing others, be impatient, will possess beautiful teeth and prattle.
saravali_navamshas.12_9: Effects of Pisces Ascendant, Sixth Navamsha: The native will be self-respected, righteous, excellent, strong, miserable, crafty, unsteady and be a minister.
saravali_navamshas.12_10: Effects of Pisces Ascendant, Seventh Navamsha: The native will be self-respected, will show interest in other religions, be excellent, be a minister, strong, miserable, cruel and unsteady.
saravali_navamshas.12_11: Effects of Pisces Ascendant, Eighth Navamsha: The native will be tall in stature, will have a big head, be emaciated, indolent, will have uneven (or dirtied) eyes and hair, will have foolish children (or a few children), be interested in earning money and be skillful in war (or quarrels).
saravali_navamshas.12_12: Effects of Pisces Ascendant, Ninth Navamsha: The native will be short, soft in disposition, courageous, broad chested, broad eyed, big nosed, be bright, will have a broad physique, be intelligent, virtuous and famous. 110. ABOUT OTHER DIVISIONS: The effects described in regard to individual signs apply to Dwadasamsas of each sign as well. Regarding effects for various other divisions not explained, the effects related to Sapthamsas will apply. Thus ends the 51st Chapter entitled "EFFECTS OF NAVAMSHAS (lost horoscopy)" in Kalyana Varma's SARAVALI. S

bphs_karakamsha.1: 12. If the Atma Karaka is in the divisions of Chandra, Mangal or Shukra, the person will visit others' wives. Otherwise, the contrary will prevail (i.e. the person will not visit others' wives). 13-18. Effects of Grahas in the Karakamsha: 0 Brahmin, if Surya is in the Karakamsha, the person will be engaged in royal assignments. If the full Chandra is there, he will enjoy pleasures and be a scholar; more so if Shukra gives a drishti to the Karakamsha. If a strong Mangal is in Karakamsha, he will use the weapons like spears, will live through fire and be an alchemist. Should a strong Buddha be Karakamsha, he will be skilful in arts and trading, and will be intelligent and educated. Guru in Karakamsha denotes a person performing good acts, endowed with spiritualism and Vedic learning. A person will be endowed with longevity of 100 years, be sensuous and will look after state affairs if Shukra is in Karakamsha. Shani in Karakamsha signifies a livelihood as is due to the person's family. Rahu in Karakamsha denotes a thief, an archer, a machinery maker, and a doctor treating poisonous afflictions. If Ketu be in Karakamsha, a person will deal in elephants and be a thief. 19-22. Rahu-Surya in Karakamsha: Should Rahu and Surya be in Karakamsha, there will be fear from snakes; if a benefic gives a drishti to Rahu-Surya in Karakamsha, there will be no fear, but a malefic drishti will bring death (through serpents). If Rahu and Surya occupy benefic Shad Vargas, being in Karakamsha, the person will be a doctor treating poisonous afflictions, while the drishti from Mangal on Rahu-Surya in Karakamsha denotes that the person will burn either his own house or that of others. Buddha's drishti on Rahu-Surya in Karakamsha will not cause the burning of a person's own house or that of others. If Rahu and Surya happen to be in Karakamsha and are in a malefic's rashi, receiving a drishti from Guru, the person will burn a house in a his neigbourhood, while the drishti of Shukra will not cause such an event. 23-24. Gulik in Karakamsha: Should the full Chandra give a drishti to Gulik placed in the Karakamsha, the person will lose his wealth to thieves or will himself be a thief. If Gulik is in Karakamsha, but does not receive a drishti from others, a person will administer poison to others, or will himself die of poisoning. Buddha's drishti in this context will give large testicles. 25-29. Effects of Drishtis on Ketu in Karakamsha: If Ketu is in Karakamsha, receiving a drishti from a malefic, one's ears will be severed or a person will suffer from diseases of the ears. Shukra giving a drishti to Ketu in Karakamsha denotes a person initiated into the religious order. A person will be devoid of strength if Buddha and Shani give a drishti to Ketu in Karakamsha. If Buddha and Shukra give a drishti to Ketu in Karakamsha, a person will be the son of a female slave or of a remarried female. With Shani's drishti on Ketu in Karakamsha, a person will perform penance or be a servant or will be a pseudo-ascetic; Shukra and Surya together giving a drishti to Ketu in Karakamsha will make a person serve the king. Thus, O Brahmin, are told briefly the effects of Karakamsha. 30-31. Effects of the 2nd from Karakamsha: If the 2nd from Karakamsha falls in the divisions of Shukra or Mangal, a person will be addicted to others' wives, and if Shukra or Mangal give a drishti to the 2nd from Karakamsha, the tendency will last till death. If Ketu is the 2nd from Karakamsha in a division of Shukra or Mangal, addiction to other's wives will not prevail, while the position of Guru will cause such an evil (i.e. addiction to other's wives). Rahu in the 2nd from Karakamsha will destroy wealth. 32. Effects of the 3rd from Karakamsha: A malefic in the 3rd from Karakamsha will make a person valorous, while a benefic in the 3rd from Karakamsha will make  a person timid. 33-35. Effects of the 4th from Karakamsha: If the 4th from Karakamsha happens to be occupied by Shukra and Chandra, a person will own large buildings, like palaces, etc. Similar, is the effect of an exalted graha in the said 4th. A house made of stones is denoted by the occupation of the 4th from Karakamsha by Rahu and Shani. Mangal and Ketu in the 4th from Karakamsha indicate a house made of bricks, ~(5I4)Ka~ while Guru in the 4th from Karakamsha denotes a house made of wood. Surya in the 4th from Karakamsha signifies a house of grass. If Chandra is in the 4th from Karakamsha, a person will have union with his wife in a house without a compound. 36-40. Effects of the 5th from Karakamsha: If Rahu and Mangal are in the 5th from Karakamsha, a person will suffer from a pulmonary consumption, more so if Chandra gives them a drishti. The drishti of Mangal on the 5th from Karakamsha will bring boils or ulcers, Ketu's drishti on the 5th from Karakamsha will cause dysentery and other diseases caused by (impure) water. If Rahu and Gulik happen to be in the 5th from Karakamsha, there will be fear from mean people and poison. Should Buddha be in the 5th from Karakamsha, the person will be an ascetic of the highest order or a person holding a staff. Surya in the 5th from Karakamsha denotes a person using a knife. Mangal in the 5th from Karakamsha denotes a person using a spear (Mangal). Shani denotes an archer if Shani is placed in the 5th from Karakamsha. Rahu in the 5th from Karakamsha denotes a machinist. Ketu in the 5th from Karakamsha denotes a watchmaker. Shukra in the 5th from Karakamsha will make a person a poet and an eloquent speaker. 41-45. Effects of Karakamsha and the 5th from there: If Guru and Chandra are in Karakamsha or the 5th thereof, the person will be an author. Shukra in Karakamsha or in the 5th from there will make a person an ordinary writer, while Buddha in Karakamsha or in the 5th from there will indicate that the writing skills are less than those of an ordinary writer. Should Guru be alone in Karakamsha, or in the 5th from there, a person will be knowledgeable about everything, be a writer, and be versed in Vedas and Vedanta philosophy, but not an orator or a grammarian. Mangal in Karakamsha or in the 5th from there denotes a logician, Buddha in Karakamsha or in the 5th from there denotes a Mimamsaka (follower of Karma Mimansa philosophy), Shani in Karakamsha or in the 5th from there indicates that a person is dull-witted in the assembly, Surya in Karakamsha or in the 5th from there denotes that a person is a musician, Chandra in Karakamsha or in the 5th from there denotes a follower of Sankhya philosophy (of Maharishi Kapila who enumerated 25 true principles with emphasis on final bliss), and indicates that a person is versed in rhetorics and singing, and Ketu or Rahu in Karakamsha or in the 5th from there denotes that  a person is a Jyotishi. Should Guru be related to the positions of Karakamsha or the 5th from there, while the Karakamsha is caused by others than him, the effects as stated will effectively come to pass. : Some say that the 2nd from Karakamsha should also be similarly considered. 46. Effects of the 6th from Karakamsha: If the 6th from Karakamsha is occupied by a malefic, the person will be an agriculturist while he will be indolent if a benefic is in the 6th from Karakamsha. d The 3rd from Karakamsha should also be similarly considered. 47-48. Effects of the 7th from Karakamsha: If Chandra and Guru are in the 7th from Karakamsha, the person will beget a very beautiful wife. Shukra in the 7th form Karakamsha denotes a sensuous wife, while Buddha in the 7th from Karakamsha indicates a wife versed in arts. Surya in the 7th from Karakamsha will give a wife who will be confined to domestic chores, while Shani in the 7th from Karakamsha denotes a wife of a higher age bracket, or a pious and/or sick wife. Rahu in the 7th from Karakamsha will bring a widow in marriage. 49. Effects of the 8th from Karakamsha: If a benefic or the graha owning the 8th from Karakamsha happens to be in the 8th from Karakamsha, the person will be long-lived, while a malefic placed in the 8th from Karakamsha will reduce the life span. Drishti/yuti of both benefics and malefics will yield a medium span of life. 50-56. Effects of the 9th from Karakamsha: If the 9th from Karakamsha receives a drishti from or is occupied by a benefic, the person will be truthful, devoted to elders and attached to his own religion. If a malefic gives a drishti to or occupies the 9th from Karakamsha, a person will be attached to his religion in boyhood, but will take to falsehood in old age. If Shani and Rahu give a drishti to or occupy the 9th from Karakamsha, a person will betray his elders and be against ancient learning. If Guru and Surya give a drishti to or occupy the 9th from Karakamsha, a person will betray his elders and will be disobedient to them. Should Mangal and Shukra give a drishti to or occupy the 9th from Karakamsha, and are joining in six identical vargas, a female ill-related to the person will die. Buddha and Chandra giving a drishti to or occupying the 9th from Karakamsha and joining in six identical vargas will lead to imprisonment of the person due to association with another female. If Guru alone is related to the 9th from Karakamsha by drishti or by yuti, the person will be addicted to females and will be devoted to sensual enjoyments. 57-60. Effects of the 10th from Karakamsha: If the 10th from Karakamsha receives a drishti from or is conjoined by a benefic, the person will have riches, be sagacious, strong, and intelligent. A malefic giving a drishti to the 10th from Karakamsha or occupying this bhava will cause harm to his profession and deprive him of paternal bliss. Buddha and Shukra giving a drishti to the 10th from Karakamsha or conjoining this bhava, will confer many gains in business (or profession) and will make him do many great deeds. Surya and Chandra giving a drishti to the 10th from Karakamsha or conjoining this place, and receiving a drishti from or be in yuti with Guru the person will acquire a kingdom. 61-62. Effects of the 11th from Karakamsha: If the 11th from Karakamsha receives a drishti from or is yuti with a benefic, the person will enjoy happiness from co-born apart from gaining in every undertaking of his. If a malefic is in the 11th from Karakamsha, the person will gain by questionable means, be famous and valorous. 63-74. Effects of the 12th from Karakamsha: If the 12th from Karakamsha has a benefic, the expenses will be on good account, while a malefic in the 12th from Karakamsha will cause bad expenses. If the 12th from Karakamsha is vacant, then also good effects (in respect of expenses) will follow. If there happens to be a benefic graha in exaltation or in own bhava in the 12th from Karakamsha or if Ketu is so placed and receives a drishti from or is yuti with a benefic, a person will attain heaven after death. A person will attain full enlightenment, if Ketu is in the 12th (from Karakamsha) identical with Mesh or Dhanu and receives a drishti from a benefic. If Ketu is in the 12th from Karakamsha, receiving a drishti from a malefic or is yuti with a malefic, a person will not attain full enlightenment. If Surya and Ketu are in the 12th from Karakamsha the person will worship Lord Shiva. Chandra and Ketu in the 12th from Karakamsha, denote a worshiper of Gauri (a consort of Lord Shiva). Shukra and Ketu in the 12th from Karakamsha, denotes a worshipper of Lakshmi (a consort of Lord Vishnu) and a wealthy person. Mangal and Ketu in the 12th from Karakamsha, denotes a worshipper of Lord Subramanya (an offspring of Lord Shiva). Rahu in the 12th from Karakamsha, will make a person worship Durga or some mean deity. Ketu alone in the 12th from Karakamsha, denotes Subramanya's or Ganesh's worshipper. If Shani is in the 12th from Karakamsha in a malefic's rashi, a person will worship mean deities. Shukra and Shani in the 12th from Karakamsha in a malefic's rashi will also make  a person worship mean deities. @ Similar inferences can be drawn from the 6th Navamsha counted f rom Amatya Karaka's Navamsha. 75-76. Miscellaneous Matters (up to sloka 84): O Brahmin, if there are two malefics in a Kon from Karakamsha, the person will have knowledge of Mantras and Tantras (formulas for the attainment of super-human powers). Y If a malefic simultaneously gives a drishti to two malefics in a Kon from Karakamsha, the person will use his learnings of Mantras and Tantras for malevolent purposes. while a benefic's drishti will make him use the learnings of Mantras and Tantras for public good, 77-84 1/2. If Chandra is in the Karakamsha receiving a drishti from Shukra, the person will be an alchemist, and if Chandra being in the Karakamsha receives a drishti from Buddha, the person will be a doctor capable of curing all diseases. If Chandra is in the 4th from Karakamsha and receives a drishti from Shukra, the person will be afflicted by white leprosy; if Chandra being in the 4th from Karakamsha receives a drishti from Mangal, the person will have blood and bilious disorders, and if Chandra being in the 4th from Karakamsha receives a drishti from Ketu, the person will suffer from black leprosy. Should Rahu and Mangal be in the 4th or 5th from Karakamsha, the person will suffer from pulmonary consumption, and if simultaneously there happens to be Chandra's drishti on the 4th or the 5th from Karakamsha, this affliction will be certain. Mangal alone in the 4th or the 5th from Karakamsha will cause ulcers. If Ketu is in the 4th or the 5th from Karakamsha, a person will suffer from dysentery and afflictions due to (impure) water. Rahu and Gulik in the 4th or the 5th from Karakamsha, will make the person a doctor curing poisonous afflictions or will cause troubles through poison. Should Shani be alone in the 4th or 5th from Karakamsha, the person will be skillful in archery. Ketu placed alone in the 4th or the 5th from Karakamsha will make a person a watchmaker. Buddha placed alone in the 4th or the 5th from Karakamsha will make a person an ascetic of the highest order or an ascetic holding staff. Rahu, Surya, and Mangal respectively in these places denote a machinist, a knife user, and a spear or arrow user. 85-86. Chandra and Guru in the Karakamsha or in the 5th therefrom denotes a writer well versed in all branches of learning. The chances of being a writer will diminish in the case of Shukra and even further in the case of Buddha, if placed in the Karakamsha or in the 5th from there. 87-92 1/2. Grahas in the 5th from Karakamsha: Should Shukra be in the 5th from Karakamsha, the person will be eloquent and will be a poet. Guru in the 5th from Karakamsha denotes that he will be an exponent. He will be all knowing, but is unable to speak in an assembly. He will further be a grammarian and a scholar in Vedas and Upanishadas. Shani in the 5th from Karakamsha will make a person ineffective in an assembly, while Buddha in the 5th from Karakamsha will make him skilful in Karma Mimansa (a person of the six  Darshanas). Mangal in Karakamsha or the 5th therefrom will make a person just, while Chandra in Karakamsha or the 5th from there denotes a Sankhya Yogi, a rhetoric, or a singer. Surya in the 5th from Karakamsha will make a person learned in Vedanta and music. Ketu in the 5th from Karakamsha will make a person a mathematician and skilful in Jyotish. Should Guru be related to the said Ketu, this knowledge will be inherited. All these as well apply to 2nd and 3rd from Karakamsha and to the Karakamsha itself, apart from applying to the 5th from Karakamsha. 93-93 1/2. Should Ketu be in the 2nd or 3rd from Karakamsha, the person will have defective speech, more so if a malefic gives a drishti to Ketu as above. 94-99. If malefics be in Karakamsha, Arudha Lagna, and the 2nd, and 8th from these places, there will be Kemadrum Yoga; the effects of this will be still severe if Chandra's drishti happens to be there. } The effects due for these yogas will come to pass in the Dasha periods of the rashis or grahas concerned. ) Kemadrum Yoga will operate additionally, if there are malefics in the 2nd and 8th from the rashi, whose Dasha will currently be in existence. The results of such Yoga will also be inauspicious. ? If the 2nd and 8th in the Kundali cast, for the beginning of a Dasha have malefics, then also Kemadrum prevails throughout the Dasha. @ L
bphs_karakamsha.2: Should Atma Karaka be in Vrishabha Navamsha, happiness from quadrupeds will be attained.
bphs_karakamsha.3: Should Atma Karaka be in Mithun Navamsha, the person will be afflicted by itching etc.
bphs_karakamsha.4: Should Atma Karaka be in Karka Navamsha, there will be fear from water, etc.
bphs_karakamsha.5: If Atma Karaka happens to be in Simha Navamsha, fear will be from tigers, etc.
bphs_karakamsha.6: If Atma Karaka happens to be in Kanya Navamsha, itching, corpulence, fire, etc., will cause trouble,
bphs_karakamsha.7: while if Atma Karaka is in Tula Navamsha, this will make a person a trader and skilful in making robes, etc.
bphs_karakamsha.8: Vrischik Navamsha holding Atma Karaka will bring trouble from snakes and also affliction to mother's breasts.
bphs_karakamsha.9: There will be a fall from height and conveyances, if it is in Dhanu Navamsha that is occupied by Atma Karaka.
bphs_karakamsha.10: Makar Navamsha in this respect denotes gains from water dwelling beings and conch, pearl, coral, etc.
bphs_karakamsha.11: If it is Kumbha Navamsha holding Atma Karaka, the person will construct tanks, etc.
bphs_karakamsha.12: And in Meen Navamsha, the Atma Karaka will grant final emancipation. The drishti of a benefic will remove evils, while that of a malefic will cause no good. 9-11. O Brahmin, if there are only benefics in Karakamsha and the Navamsha of Lagna and receives a drishti from a benefic, the person will undoubtedly become a king. Should the Kendras/Konas from the Karakamsha be occupied by benefics devoid of malefic association, the person will be endowed with wealth and learning. n The combination of benefic and malefic influence will, in this context, yield mixed results. If the Upakheta (or Upa Graha, vide ch.32 sloka 5) is in its exaltation, or own, or friendly rashi, and is devoid of a drishti from a malefic, the person will go to heaven after death.

saravali_drekkanas.1_1: One born in the first decanate of Aries will be charitable, be a thief, be splendorous, will have checkered prosperity, be fierce in battle (or in quarrels), pleasing in appearance and will inflict punishment on relatives.
saravali_drekkanas.1_5: If born in the second decanate of Aries, he will be attached to females, will wander, be interested in carnal pleasures and music, be intelligent, be endowed with friends and wealth, be good-looking and will have an eye on women's property.
saravali_drekkanas.1_9: If born in the third decanate of Aries, he will be virtuous, will fault others, be fickle minded, mighty, will serve a king, be attached to his own men, be very righteous and honorable but not learned. 4-6. DECANATES IN TAURUS :
saravali_drekkanas.2_2: If the birth be in the first decanate of Taurus, one will be fond of food and drinks, be tormented due to separation of his wife, endowed with robes and ornaments and will act according to the desires of his wife.
saravali_drekkanas.2_6: If the birth be in the second decanate of Taurus, one will be beautiful, liked by women, will have large lips, be endowed with beauty and wealth, firmly wealthy, intelligent and attached to mean women.
saravali_drekkanas.2_10: If the birth be in the third decanate of Taurus, one will be skillful, be not very fortunate, be valorous, dirty and will repent after spending money. 7-9. DECANATES IN GEMINI:
saravali_drekkanas.3_3: One born in the first decanate of Gemini will have broad and excellent limbs, be wealthy, lofty, deceiving, virtuous, sportive, honoured by the king and be a good speaker.
saravali_drekkanas.3_7: One born in the second decanate of Gemini will be miserly, dreaming, conquered by the fair sex, self respected, endowed with co-born, fickle-minded, sportive and tormented by many diseases.
saravali_drekkanas.3_11: One born in the third decanate of Gemini will hate women, will have a large head, will have enemies, be lofty, will possess rough nails and will not have firm wealth. 10-12. DECANATES IN CANCER:
saravali_drekkanas.4_4: One born in the first decanate of Cancer will honour Brahmins and gods, be fickle-minded, fair in complexion, will help others, be intelligent, pleasing in appearance, will possess a fortunate wife and be himself fortunate.
saravali_drekkanas.4_8: One born in the second decanate of Cancer will be miserly, dreaming, conquered by the fair sex, self-respected, endowed with co-born, fickle minded, sportive and be tormented by many diseases.
saravali_drekkanas.4_12: One born in the third decanate of Cancer will lose his firmness to females, be wealthy, intent on living in foreign places, fond of wine, be virtuous, will have liking for forests wine, have diseased eyes and will like garlands etc. 13-l5. DECANATES IN LEO:
saravali_drekkanas.5_5: One born in the first decanate of Leo will be liberal, will maintain people, will conquer his enemies, will have abundant wealth, many wives and good friends, will serve many kings and be very mighty.
saravali_drekkanas.5_9: One born in the second decanate of Leo will perform beneficial acts, be liberal, firm, fond of quarrels, happy, will follow the rules of Vedas and be intelligent.
saravali_drekkanas.5_1: One born in the third decanate of Leo will be a miser, will steal others' wealth, be free from sickness, hard-hearted, very intelligent, roguish, will have a narrow physique, be pre-eminent and will have many children. 16-18. DECANATES IN VIRGO:
saravali_drekkanas.6_6: One born in the first decanate of Virgo will be dark in complexion, will speak affably, be modest, lofty, beautiful, will gain wealth through females, be ominous and will have a long head and honey colored eyes.
saravali_drekkanas.6_10: One born in the second decanate of Virgo will be bold, will live in foreign places, be skillful in fine arts, fables and battles, be garrulous, will honour Vedic teachings and be dear to forest tribes.
saravali_drekkanas.6_2: Birth in the third decanate of Virgo indicates one enjoying music and other's wealth. He will be dear to king, short in stature and will be endowed with large head and large eyes. 19-21. DECANATES IN LIBRA:
saravali_drekkanas.7_7: If the ascendant be in the first decanate of Libra, one will be akin to Cupid in physical charm, be skillful, will enjoy travels, be dark in complexion, fond of arts and business, will fulfill appointed tasks and be very learned.
